verdict.rationale: Whether a CRM SaaS uses customer data to train AI models is a fair privacy question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy or similar control. Data export, permissions, record restore and 2FA are adjacent security and privacy features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
